gaps: No official roster besides SIPRI and Kommerskollegium found this pass; SIEPS lead unresolved.

classification_rules: Only affiliations corroborated by an official source (SIPRI pages or Kommerskollegium pages) were written as relation records.

Self-authored or third-party social profiles (Twitter mirror, LinkedIn) were treated as leads, not evidence; the Twitter bio's older 'Internal Market Department' wording was not used because the official page currently says EU Trade Policy.
A SIEPS association seen in a LinkedIn post reference was left unresolved.

findings.result: SIPRI's bio page still lists Agnès Courades Allebeck with her SIPRI publication (Research Report No. 3, 1990).

Researcher in the 1990s: co-author of SIPRI Research Report No. 3 'West European Arms Production' (1990), 'Arms Export Regulations' (1991), 'Arms Industry Limited' (1993) chapters, and SIPRI Yearbook military-expenditure chapters through 1998.

Head of the Department for EU Trade Policy (Enheten för EU:s handelspolitik) at the National Board of Trade Sweden; listed on the official organisation page (updated 2025-01-02) and the management-team page; moderated an agency seminar at EU Days Lund 2023 as Head of Department.

The SIPRI publications (Agnes/Agnès Courades Allebeck) and the Kommerskollegium listings (Agnès Courades Allebeck) are treated as the same person; name variants without the accent are recorded as aliases.
A SIEPS (Swedish Institute for European Policy Studies) association appears in a LinkedIn post reference; no official SIEPS roster listing found this pass.
Twitter/X handle @ACouradesA appears only via a third-party profile mirror; not recorded without a first-party source.

data.method: Read the target and seed records; re-verified the SIPRI bio page; reviewed SIPRI publication and Yearbook records establishing her 1990s researcher role; Brave-searched her current affiliations; corroborated the government role against the National Board of Trade Sweden's official organisation and management-team pages; wrote the org/relation records and version-bumped the person and seed relation through the canonical batch importer.
